---
title: Bagna Cauda
id: MAR-0017
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 9 salted anchovies
- 3 garlic cloves
- 1 dl of milk
- 3 dl of extra virgin olive oil
## Method
1. Peel the garlic, soak it in milk for 2 hours, then drain it and crush it in a mortar.
2. Desalt the anchovies under running water, remove the bones, dry them, and cut them into pieces.
3. Dissolve the anchovies and garlic in a terracotta container and cook stirring for 10 minutes.
4. Serve the bagna cauda as soon as it is removed from the heat on the appropriate small stove, accompanying it with sticks of raw vegetables (Monferrato cardoon, peppers, spring onions...).
